hero.heroesjourney.batman.description: Become Gotham's Dark Knight: a vow born of grief, forged through training, investigation, and discipline.

quest.heroesjourney.batman.1.title: The Oath
quest.heroesjourney.batman.1.description: That day, an innocent dies before your eyes, victim of a violence nothing could justify. From that loss a vow is born: never again unpunished.
quest.heroesjourney.batman.2.title: In the Shadows
quest.heroesjourney.batman.2.description: Brute force draws attention. True mastery begins with learning to vanish into the dark, to watch without being seen.
quest.heroesjourney.batman.3.title: Body and Discipline
quest.heroesjourney.batman.3.description: The body is a weapon that must be forged before anything else. Running, jumping, swimming: every effort brings you closer to what you must become.
quest.heroesjourney.batman.4.title: Mind
quest.heroesjourney.batman.4.description: To stand against criminals, strengthening the body is not enough. The mind must be strengthened too.
quest.heroesjourney.batman.5.title: The Fighter
quest.heroesjourney.batman.5.description: Bare fists reveal a fighter's true measure. No gadget, no weapon - only the body's discipline against the fear it inspires.
quest.heroesjourney.batman.6.title: A Sign in the Night
quest.heroesjourney.batman.6.description: A beating of wings in the dark, nothing more. Yet some signs take hold of us without reason - and become symbols.
quest.heroesjourney.batman.7.title: Birth of a Legend
quest.heroesjourney.batman.7.description: The armour does not make the hero, but it seals the transformation. Tonight, Gotham no longer has a mere vigilante - it has a legend.
